amendment.provenance_change_from_v1: Bind q128 directly to the byte-identical q256 canonical CIFAR-10 training ZIP and replace the legacy-equivalence wait gate with an exhaustive canonical-loader smoke.

research_question: Does the q256 A-to-B pair-spacing effect replicate when the only intended scientific change is schedule q=128?

scope.optimizer_note: RAdam remains a frozen training constant inherited from q256; it is not an experimental arm or a new RAdam study.

provenance_gate.legacy_asset_policy: PR31/PR32 q128 checkpoints and metrics remain historical exploratory evidence and are never used, mixed, resumed, or substituted in this matrix.
provenance_gate.dataset_binding_rule: Every q128 cell must read the exact q256 canonical training archive whose byte SHA256 is frozen here.

source_contract.allowed_change_from_reference: scientific CLI q: 256 -> 128; validation-only source amendment admits q=128 to the otherwise unchanged strict path

strict_protocol_q_scope_amendment.reason: The first authorized launch was rejected before run-directory creation by the q256-only validation guard.
strict_protocol_q_scope_amendment.amended_behavior: q must be one of 128 or 256
required_parity_tests: q256 A equals native sigmoid bitwise
q256 B equals native global_sigmoid g=1.10 bitwise
q128 A equals native sigmoid bitwise
q128 B equals native global_sigmoid g=1.10 bitwise

runtime_execution.amendment_reason: six GPUs supplied; run one independent seed-by-arm cell per GPU
runtime_execution.pairing_note: Concurrent execution does not change the paired unit; A and B remain paired by training seed.

primary.rationale: The q256 NFE1 FID-50k curve approaches and crosses FID 10 between 768 and 896 kimg; 640 and 1024 bracket that region and 512 anchors the sharp quality transition.

secondary.kid: kid50k_full from the same generated features as every primary job

evaluation.completion_rule: Execution priority is scheduling only, never an adaptive selection policy. Report the primary curve only after all 30 NFE1 seed-by-arm-by-budget jobs pass; no early result may cancel, add, replace, or select a frozen budget. Secondary NFE2 incompleteness must be explicit and must not alter the primary set.

analysis.primary_summary: Per-budget A and B FID-50k values, paired B-A deltas, mean paired delta, sample SD, range, and directional wins out of three.
analysis.secondary_summary: KID-50k and NFE2 descriptive paired summaries using the same seed-level unit.
forbidden: checkpoint selection based on observed FID or KID
mixing legacy q128 cells into the frozen matrix
treating checkpoints or sample seeds as independent training replicates
